095 *  <p>{@summary The factory for the various JavaComposer artefacts.}</p>
096 *  <p>Instances of this class do not maintain a state, therefore they are
097 *  thread-safe without any synchronisation.</p>
098 *
099 *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
100 *  @version $Id: JavaComposer.java 1258 2026-06-04 18:33:06Z tquadrat $
101 *  @since 0.2.0
102 *
103 *  @UMLGraph.link
104 */

227    /**
228     *  Creates a new instance of {@code JavaComposer} that uses the default
229     *  {@link Layout#LAYOUT_DEFAULT Layout} and adds some debug information
230     *  to the output.
231     *
232     *  @param  addDebugOutput  {@true} if debug information should be
233     *      added,  {@false} if not.

240    /**
241     *  Creates a new instance of {@code JavaComposer}.
242     *
243     *  @param  layout  The layout that is used to format the output.
244     *  @param  addDebugOutput  {@true} if debug information should be
245     *      added,  {@false} if not.
246     */
247    public JavaComposer( final Layout layout, final boolean addDebugOutput )
248    {
249        m_Layout = requireNonNullArgument( layout, "layout" );
250        m_AddDebugOutput = addDebugOutput;
251
252        //---* The inherited doc comment *-------------------------------------
253        final var codeBlockSupplier = (Supplier<CodeBlock>) () ->
254        {
255            final var retValue = new CodeBlockImpl.BuilderImpl( this )
256                .addWithoutDebugInfo( "$L\n", JAVADOC_TAG_INHERITDOC )
257                .build();
258
259            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
260            return retValue;
261        };
262        m_JavaDoc_InheritDoc = Lazy.use( codeBlockSupplier );
263        final var inheritDocComment = codeBlockSupplier.get();
264
265        //---* The @ClassVersion annotation *----------------------------------
266        final var annotationSpecSupplierClassVersion = (Supplier<AnnotationSpec>) () ->
267        {
268            final var retValue = annotationBuilder( ClassVersion.class )
269                .forceInline( true )
270                .addMember( "sourceVersion", "$S", "Generated with JavaComposer" )
271                .addMember( "isGenerated", "$L", "true" )
272                .build();
273
274            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
275            return retValue;
276        };
277        m_Annotation_ClassVersion = Lazy.use( annotationSpecSupplierClassVersion );
278
279        //---* The @UtilityClass annotation *----------------------------------
280        final var annotationSpecSupplierUtilityClass = (Supplier<AnnotationSpec>) () ->
281        {
282            final var retValue = annotationBuilder( UtilityClass.class )
283                .forceInline( true )
284                .build();
285
286            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
287            return retValue;
288        };
289        m_Annotation_UtilityClass = Lazy.use( annotationSpecSupplierUtilityClass );
290
291        //---* The equals() method *-------------------------------------------
292        var methodSpecSupplier = (Supplier<MethodSpec>) () ->
293        {
294            final var retValue = methodBuilder( "equals" )
295                .addJavadoc( inheritDocComment )
296                .addAnnotation( Override.class )
297                .addModifiers( PUBLIC )
298                .addParameter( Object.class, "o", FINAL )
299                .returns( BOOLEAN )
300                .build();
301
302            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
303            return retValue;
304        };
305        m_Method_Equals = Lazy.use( methodSpecSupplier );
306
307        //---* The hashCode() method *-----------------------------------------
308        methodSpecSupplier = () ->
309        {
310            final var retValue = methodBuilder( "hashCode" )
311                .addJavadoc( inheritDocComment )
312                .addAnnotation( Override.class )
313                .addModifiers( PUBLIC )
314                .returns( INT )
315                .build();
316
317            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
318            return retValue;
319        };
320        m_Method_HashCode = Lazy.use( methodSpecSupplier );
321
322        //---* The toString() method *-----------------------------------------
323        methodSpecSupplier = () ->
324        {
325            final var retValue = methodBuilder( "toString" )
326                .addJavadoc( inheritDocComment )
327                .addAnnotation( Override.class )
328                .addModifiers( PUBLIC )
329                .returns( String.class )
330                .build();
331
332            //---* Done *------------------------------------------------------
333            return retValue;
334        };
335        m_Method_ToString = Lazy.use( methodSpecSupplier );
336    }   //  JavaComposer()

550    /**
551     *  Creates an instance of
552     *  {@link AnnotationSpec}
553     *  from the given
554     *  {@link Annotation}
555     *  instance.
556     *
557     *  @param  annotation  The annotation.
558     *  @return The new instance of {@code AnnotationSpec}.
559     */
560    public final AnnotationSpec createAnnotation( final Annotation annotation )
561    {
562        final var retValue = createAnnotation( annotation, false );
563
564        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
565        return retValue;
566    }   //  createAnnotation()

568    /**
569     *  Creates an instance of
570     *  {@link AnnotationSpec}
571     *  from the given
572     *  {@link Annotation}
573     *  instance.
574     *
575     *  @param  annotation  The annotation.
576     *  @param  includeDefaultValues    {@true} to include the
577     *      annotation's default values, {@false} to ignore them.
578     *  @return The new instance of {@code AnnotationSpec}.
579     */
580    public final AnnotationSpec createAnnotation( final Annotation annotation, final boolean includeDefaultValues )
581    {
582        final var builder = (AnnotationSpecImpl.BuilderImpl) annotationBuilder( ClassName.from( requireNonNullArgument( annotation, "annotation" ).annotationType() ) );
583        try
584        {
585            final var methods = annotation.annotationType().getDeclaredMethods();
586            sort( methods, comparing( Method::getName ) );
587            MethodsLoop: for( final var method : methods )
588            {
589                final var value = method.invoke( annotation );
590                if( !includeDefaultValues )
591                {
592                    if( deepEquals( value, method.getDefaultValue() ) ) continue MethodsLoop;
593                }
594                if( value.getClass().isArray() )
595                {
596                    for( var i = 0; i < Array.getLength( value ); ++i )
597                    {
598                        builder.addMemberForValue( method.getName(), Array.get( value, i ) );
599                    }
600                    continue MethodsLoop;
601                }
602                if( value instanceof final Annotation annotationValue )
603                {
604                    builder.addMember( method.getName(), "$L", createAnnotation( annotationValue, false ) );
605                    continue MethodsLoop;
606                }
607                builder.addMemberForValue( method.getName(), value );
608            }   //  MethodsLoop:
609        }
610        catch( final SecurityException | IllegalAccessException | IllegalArgumentException | InvocationTargetException e )
611        {
612            throw new JavaComposerException( "Reflecting " + annotation + " failed!", e );
613        }
614        final var retValue = builder.build();
615
616        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
617        return retValue;
618    }   //  createAnnotation()
619
620    /**
621     *  Creates an instance of
622     *  {@link AnnotationSpec}
623     *  from the given
624     *  {@link AnnotationMirror}
625     *  instance.
626     *
627     *  @param  annotation  The annotation mirror.
628     *  @return The new instance of {@code AnnotationSpec}.
629     */
630    public final AnnotationSpec createAnnotation( final AnnotationMirror annotation )
631    {
632        final var element = (TypeElement) requireNonNullArgument( annotation, "annotation" ).getAnnotationType().asElement();
633        final var builder = (AnnotationSpecImpl.BuilderImpl) annotationBuilder( ClassName.from( element ) );
634        final var visitor = new AnnotationValueVisitor( builder );
635        for( final var executableElement : annotation.getElementValues().keySet() )
636        {
637            final var name = executableElement.getSimpleName().toString();
638            @SuppressWarnings( "unlikely-arg-type" )
639            final var value = annotation.getElementValues().get( executableElement );
640            value.accept( visitor, name );
641        }
642        final var retValue = builder.build();
643
644        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
645        return retValue;
646    }   //  createAnnotation()

658    /**
659     *  Returns a {@code @ClassVersion} annotation with the text for
660     *  {@link ClassVersion#sourceVersion()}.
661     *
662     *  @param  sourceVersion   The text.
663     *  @return The annotation.
664     *
665     *  @see    ClassVersion
666     */
667    public final AnnotationSpec createClassVersionAnnotation( final String sourceVersion )
668    {
669        final var retValue = annotationBuilder( ClassVersion.class )
670            .forceInline( true )
671            .addMember( "sourceVersion", "$S", requireNotEmptyArgument( sourceVersion, "sourceVersion" ) )

702                    """, JAVADOC_TAG_VALUE ) );
703            }
704        }
705
706        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
707        return retValue;
708    }   //  createComment4Constant()

932    /**
933     *  <p>{@summary Creates a
934     *  {@link MethodSpec}
935     *  for the given
936     *  {@link ExecutableElement}.}</p>
937     *  <p>This method copies visibility modifiers, type parameters, return
938     *  type, name, parameters, and {@code throws} declarations, but not the
939     *  body (if any).</p>
940     *
941     *  @note   The annotations will not be copied and must be added separately.
942     *
943     *  @param  method  The method to override.
944     *  @return The builder.
945     */
946    public final MethodSpec createMethod( final ExecutableElement method )
947    {
948        final var methodName = requireNonNullArgument( method, "method" ).getSimpleName();
949        final var builder = methodBuilder( methodName )
950            .addModifiers( method.getModifiers() )
951            .returns( TypeName.from( method.getReturnType() ) )
952            .addParameters( parametersOf( method ) )
953            .varargs( method.isVarArgs() );
954
955        for( final var typeParameterElement : method.getTypeParameters() )
956        {
957            final var typeVariable = (TypeVariable) typeParameterElement.asType();
958            builder.addTypeVariable( TypeVariableName.from( typeVariable ) );
959        }
960
961        for( final var thrownType : method.getThrownTypes() )
962        {
963            builder.addException( TypeName.from( thrownType ) );
964        }
965
966        //---* Create the return value *---------------------------------------
967        final var retValue = builder.build();
968
969        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
970        return retValue;
971    }   //  createMethod()

1056    /**
1057     *  <p>{@summary Returns a builder for a static class.}</p>
1058     *  <p>A <i>static class</i> is a {@code final} class with a
1059     *  {@code private} constructor that has only {@code static} members; no
1060     *  instances are allowed for such a class, so none of the {@code static}
1061     *  methods are factories for that class.</p>
1062     *  <p>This would be the skeleton for the new static class:</p>
1063     *  <pre><code>  &lt;package <i>what.ever.package.was.chosen</i>&gt;;
1064     *
1065     *  import org.tquadrat.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
1066     *  import org.tquadrat.foundation.annotation.UtilityClass;
1067     *  import org.tquadrat.foundation.exception.PrivateConstructorForStaticClassCalledError;
1068     *
1069     *  &#64;UtilityClass
1070     *  &#64;ClassVersion(sourceVersion = "Generated with JavaComposer", isGenerated = true)
1071     *  public final class StaticClass {
1072     *    &#47;**
1073     *     * No instance allowed for this class!
1074     *     *&#47;
1075     *    private StaticClass() {
1076     *      throw new PrivateConstructorForStaticClassCalledError( StaticClass.class );
1077     *    }
1078     *  }</code></pre>
1079     *
1080     *  @param  className   The name of the new class.
1081     *  @return The builder.
1082     *
1083     *  @see    ClassVersion
1084     *  @see    PrivateConstructorForStaticClassCalledError
1085     *  @see    UtilityClass
1086     */
1087    public final TypeSpec.Builder createStaticClassBuilder( final CharSequence className )
1088    {
1089        requireValidNonNullArgument( className, "className", v -> SourceVersion.isName( requireNotEmptyArgument( v, "className" ) ), (_,v) -> "not a valid name: %s".formatted( v ) );
1090        final var constructor = constructorBuilder()
1091            .addModifiers( PRIVATE )
1092            .addJavadoc(
1093                """
1094                No instance allowed for this class!
1095                """ )
1096            .addStatement( "throw new $T( $L.class )", PrivateConstructorForStaticClassCalledError.class, className )
1097            .build();
1098        final var retValue = classBuilder( className )
1099            .addModifiers( PUBLIC, FINAL )
1100            .addAnnotation( createUtilityClassAnnotation() )
1101            .addAnnotation( createClassVersionAnnotation() )
1102            .addMethod( constructor );
1103
1104        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
1105        return retValue;
1106    }   //  createStaticClassBuilder()
1107

1406    /**
1407     *  <p>{@summary Returns a new method builder for a method that overrides
1408     *  the given method.}</p>
1409     *  <p>This new builder will copy visibility modifiers, type parameters,
1410     *  return type, name, parameters, and {@code throws} declarations. An
1411     *  {@link Override}
1412     *  annotation will be added.</p>
1413     *
1414     *  @note In JavaPoet&nbsp;1.2 through 1.7 this method retained annotations
1415     *      from the method and parameters of the overridden method. Since
1416     *      JavaPoet&nbsp;1.8 and in JavaComposer annotations must be added
1417     *      separately.
1418     *
1419     *  @param  method  The method to override.
1420     *  @return The builder.
1421     */
1422    public final MethodSpec.Builder overridingMethodBuilder( final ExecutableElement method )
1423    {
1424        final var enclosingClass = requireNonNullArgument( method, "method" ).getEnclosingElement();
1425        if( enclosingClass.getModifiers().contains( FINAL ) )
1426        {
1427            //noinspection UnnecessaryToStringCall
1428            throw new IllegalArgumentException( format( MSG_CannotOverrideFinalClass, enclosingClass.toString() ) );
1429        }
1430
1431        var modifiers = method.getModifiers();
1432        if( modifiers.contains( PRIVATE ) || modifiers.contains( FINAL ) || modifiers.contains( STATIC ) )
1433        {
1434            throw new IllegalArgumentException( format( MSG_CannotOverrideMethod, modifiers.stream().map( Enum::name ).collect( joining( "', '" ) ) ) );
1435        }
1436
1437        final var methodName = method.getSimpleName().toString();
1438        final var retValue = methodBuilder( methodName );
1439
1440        retValue.addAnnotation( Override.class );
1441
1442        modifiers = new LinkedHashSet<>( modifiers );
1443        modifiers.remove( ABSTRACT );
1444        modifiers.remove( DEFAULT );
1445        retValue.addModifiers( modifiers );
1446
1447        for( final var typeParameterElement : method.getTypeParameters() )
1448        {
1449            final var typeVariable = (TypeVariable) typeParameterElement.asType();
1450            retValue.addTypeVariable( TypeVariableName.from( typeVariable ) );
1451        }
1452
1453        retValue.returns( TypeName.from( method.getReturnType() ) );
1454
1455        retValue.addParameters( parametersOf( method ) );
1456        retValue.varargs( method.isVarArgs() );
1457
1458        for( final var thrownType : method.getThrownTypes() )
1459        {
1460            retValue.addException( TypeName.from( thrownType ) );
1461        }
1462
1463        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
1464        return retValue;
1465    }   //  overridingMethodBuilder()
1466
1467    /**
1468     *  <p>{@summary Returns a new method builder that overrides the given
1469     *  method as a member of of the given enclosing class.} This will resolve
1470     *  type parameters: for example overriding
1471     *  {@link Comparable#compareTo}
1472     *  in a type that implements {@code Comparable<Movie>}, the {@code T}
1473     *  parameter will be resolved to {@code Movie}.</p>
1474     *  <p>This will copy its visibility modifiers, type parameters, return
1475     *  type, name, parameters, and {@code throws} declarations. An
1476     *  {@link Override}
1477     *  annotation will be added.</p>
1478     *
1479     *  @note In JavaPoet&nbsp;1.2 through 1.7 this method retained annotations
1480     *      from the method and parameters of the overridden method. Since
1481     *      JavaPoet&nbsp;1.8 and in JavaComposer annotations must be added
1482     *      separately.
1483     *
1484     *  @param  method  The method to override.
1485     *  @param  enclosing   The enclosing class for the method.
1486     *  @param  typeUtils   An implementation of some utility methods for
1487     *      operating on types, as provided by the processing environment of an
1488     *      annotation processor.
1489     *  @return The builder.
1490     */
1491    public final MethodSpec.Builder overridingMethodBuilder( final ExecutableElement method, final DeclaredType enclosing, final Types typeUtils )
1492    {
1493        final var executableType = (ExecutableType) requireNonNullArgument( typeUtils, "types" ).asMemberOf( requireNonNullArgument( enclosing, "enclosing" ), requireNonNullArgument( method, "method" ) );
1494        final var resolvedParameterTypes = executableType.getParameterTypes();
1495        final var resolvedThrownTypes = executableType.getThrownTypes();
1496        final var resolvedReturnType = executableType.getReturnType();
1497
1498        final var retValue = (MethodSpecImpl.BuilderImpl) overridingMethodBuilder( method );
1499        retValue.returns( TypeName.from( resolvedReturnType ) );
1500        final var parameters = retValue.parameters();
1501        for( int i = 0, size = parameters.size(); i < size; ++i )
1502        {
1503            final var parameter = parameters.get( i );
1504            final var type = TypeName.from( resolvedParameterTypes.get( i ) );
1505            parameters.set( i, parameter.toBuilder( type, parameter.name(), true ).build() );
1506        }
1507        retValue.exceptions().clear();
1508        for( final var resolvedThrownType : resolvedThrownTypes )
1509        {
1510            retValue.addException( TypeName.from( resolvedThrownType ) );
1511        }
1512
1513        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
1514        return retValue;
1515    }   //  overridingMethodBuilder()
1516
1517    /**
1518     *  <p>{@summary Returns a new method builder for a method that overrides
1519     *  the given method.}</p>
1520     *  <p>This new builder will copy visibility modifiers, type parameters,
1521     *  return type, name, parameters, and {@code throws} declarations. An
1522     *  {@link Override}
1523     *  annotation will be added, but any other annotation will be omitted;
1524     *  this is consistent with the behaviour of
1525     *  {@link #overridingMethodBuilder(ExecutableElement)}
1526     *  and
1527     *  {@link #overridingMethodBuilder(ExecutableElement, DeclaredType, Types)}.</p>
1528     *
1529     *  @param  method  The method to override.
1530     *  @return The builder.
1531     */
1532    public final MethodSpec.Builder overridingMethodBuilder( final Method method )
1533    {
1534        final var enclosingClass = requireNonNullArgument( method, "method" ).getDeclaringClass();
1535        if( translateModifiers( enclosingClass.getModifiers() ).contains( FINAL ) )
1536        {
1537            throw new IllegalArgumentException( format( MSG_CannotOverrideFinalClass, enclosingClass.getName() ) );
1538        }
1539
1540        var modifiers = translateModifiers( method.getModifiers() );
1541        if( modifiers.contains( PRIVATE ) || modifiers.contains( FINAL ) || modifiers.contains( STATIC ) )
1542        {
1543            throw new IllegalArgumentException( format( MSG_CannotOverrideMethod, modifiers.stream().map( Enum::name ).collect( joining( "', '" ) ) ) );
1544        }
1545        final var methodName = method.getName();
1546        final var retValue = methodBuilder( methodName );
1547
1548        retValue.addAnnotation( Override.class );
1549
1550        modifiers = new LinkedHashSet<>( modifiers );
1551        modifiers.remove( ABSTRACT );
1552        modifiers.remove( DEFAULT );
1553        retValue.addModifiers( modifiers );
1554
1555        for( final var typeParameterVariable : method.getTypeParameters() )
1556        {
1557            retValue.addTypeVariable( TypeVariableName.from( typeParameterVariable ) );
1558        }
1559
1560        retValue.returns( TypeName.from( method.getReturnType() ) );
1561
1562        retValue.addParameters( parametersOf( method ) );
1563        retValue.varargs( method.isVarArgs() );
1564
1565        for( final var thrownType : method.getExceptionTypes() )
1566        {
1567            retValue.addException( TypeName.from( thrownType ) );
1568        }
1569
1570        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
1571        return retValue;
1572    }   //  overridingMethodBuilder()
1573
